name: Glossary & Index help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Glossary & Index plugin: the page, its three views, the filters, the detail panel and its settings.
author: Brett

entries.title: Glossary & Index
entries.text: Everything in AmberX AXF in one place: every plugin, feature, screen, control, setting, command, asset and tool, defined in the Glossary, filed in the Index and listed in the Grid.

entries.title: Glossary & Index settings
entries.text: Which view the page opens in, how entries are sorted, how many are drawn at once, whether draft help shows, and a button to rebuild the catalog now.

entries.title: Drafts
entries.text: On: controls whose help text is still a draft (made from the code, not reviewed yet) are listed too. Off: only reviewed entries.

entries.title: Only undescribed
entries.text: Shows only entries whose source has no description of its own, so you can see what still needs writing. Their summary is generated.

entries.title: Close details
entries.text: Closes the detail panel and gives the list the full width again.

entries.title: Rebuild now
entries.text: Rebuilds the glossary and index from the registries right away (it also rebuilds by itself after every build) and says how many entries were added, changed or removed.

entries.title: Show draft help entries
entries.text: Whether controls with draft help text are listed by default.

entries.title: Expand all
entries.text: Opens every heading of the index, all the way down.

entries.title: Collapse all
entries.text: Closes every heading of the index back to the top-level categories.

entries.title: Copy entry id
entries.text: Copies this entry's id (for example plugin:build-manager) so you can use it with the API, MCP tools or the command line.

entries.title: Show more
entries.text: Draws the next page of entries; set the page size in the plugin's settings.

steps.say: This is the encyclopedia of the whole system: every plugin, feature, screen, control, setting, command, asset and tool has an entry here.
Type in Search to find anything; every word has to match. Pick a kind to narrow it down.
Switch between the A to Z Glossary, the categorized Index and the Grid with the tabs. Tap any entry to see what it does, where it appears, its API and what it links to.
